# Proximity navigation notification behavior (2026-01-18 15:40Z)

_**User**_

right now during navigation, when the two devices are closing in within 50m the navigation will show a notification for a couple of seconds and dismiss the navigation and switch back to the device list.

this needs to be changed in this way:

- the notification should be shown for a longer period, at lest 6 seconds
- the dismiss should only stop the navigation but keep the user on the map with the target device showing

---

_**Agent (model default, mode Agent)**_


Searching for the code that handles the 50m proximity notification and navigation dismissal.

        "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",
        "signatures": {},

The threshold is configurable to balance accuracy vs. cost.\n        let threshold: CLLocationDistance = routeReuseDistanceThreshold\n        var userMoved = false\n        if let current = userCoordinate, let last = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n            let distance = CLLocation(latitude: current.latitude, longitude: current.longitude)\n                .distance(from: CLLocation(latitude: last.latitude, longitude: last.longitude))\n            userMoved = distance &gt; threshold\n        } else if lastRouteUserCoordinate == nil {\n            userMoved = true\n        }\n        var deviceMoved = false\n        if let current = deviceCoordinate, let last = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n            let distance = CLLocation(latitude: current.latitude, longitude: current.longitude)\n                .distance(from: CLLocation(latitude: last.latitude, longitude: last.longitude))\n            deviceMoved = distance &gt; threshold\n        } else if lastRouteDeviceCoordinate == nil {\n            deviceMoved = true\n        }\n        return userMoved || deviceMoved\n    }\n\n    private func stopAutoUpdate() {\n        timerCancellable?.cancel()\n        timerCancellable = nil\n    }\n\n    private func restartAutoUpdate() {\n        startAutoUpdate()\n    }\n\n    // Removed: restartTimeUpdateTimer().         "contents": "    private func handleIncomingURL(_ url: URL) {\n        guard url.scheme == \"miataru\" else { return }\n        let deviceID = (url.host ?? \"\").uppercased()\n        guard !deviceID.isEmpty else { return }\n\n        Task { @MainActor in\n            // When resuming from background, SwiftUI may restore navigation state after the URL\n            // event is delivered. Deferring slightly ensures the deep link wins over restoration.\n            await Task.yield()\n            try? await Task.sleep(nanoseconds: 180_000_000)\n\n            // If the device already exists, navigate to it; otherwise fall back to add flow.\n            if KnownDeviceStore.shared.devices.contains(where: { $0.DeviceID == deviceID }) {\n                showAddDeviceSheet = false\n                pendingDeviceID = nil\n                SettingsManager.shared.lastOpenedDeviceID = deviceID\n            } else {\n                pendingDeviceID = deviceID\n                showAddDeviceSheet = true\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nprivate struct DeviceWindowEntrypoint: View {\n    @Binding var deviceID: String?\n    @Environment(\\.openWindow) private var openWindow\n    @Environment(\\.dismissWindow) private var dismissWindow\n\n    init(deviceID: Binding&lt;String?&gt;) {\n        self._deviceID = deviceID\n    }\n\n    var body: some View {\n        Group {\n            if let id = deviceID {\n                iPad_DeviceMapView(deviceID: id)\n            } else {\n                Text(NSLocalizedString(\"no_device_selected\", comment: \"No device selected for this window.\"))\n            }\n        }\n        .task {\n            if LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation {\n                LaunchGuard.isFirstActivation = false\n                openWindow(id: \"main\")\n                if let id = deviceID {\n                    dismissWindow(value: id)\n                }\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}",

        "contents": "    private func calculateRoute(ignoreCache: Bool = false) {\n        // Calculate a new route between user and selected device.\n        // Prefers a cached route when movement &lt; 100m; applies a daily network request limit.\n        guard let user = userCoordinate, let device = deviceCoordinate else { return }\n        // Try to reuse cached route first unless explicitly told to ignore cache\n        if !ignoreCache {\n            if useCachedRouteIfValid() { return }\n            // Only recalc when one of the positions changed since the last route calculation (or if there's no route yet)\n            let userTimestampChanged = userTimestamp != lastRouteUserTimestamp\n            let deviceTimestampChanged = deviceTimestamp != lastRouteDeviceTimestamp\n            var userCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastUser = lastRouteUserCoordinate {\n                userCoordinatesChanged = (lastUser.latitude != user.latitude) || (lastUser.longitude != user.longitude)\n            }\n            var deviceCoordinatesChanged = true\n            if let lastDevice = lastRouteDeviceCoordinate {\n                deviceCoordinatesChanged = (lastDevice.latitude != device.latitude) || (lastDevice.longitude != device.longitude)\n            }\n            let transportTypeChanged = settings.navigationTransportType != lastRouteTransportType\n            let shouldRecalculate = (route == nil) || userTimestampChanged || deviceTimestampChanged || userCoordinatesChanged || deviceCoordinatesChanged || transportTypeChanged\n            if !shouldRecalculate { return }\n        }\n\n        // Enforce daily limit through centralized counter with calendar-day reset\n        routeCounter.checkAndResetIfNeeded()\n        guard routeCounter.count &lt; routeRequestDailyLimit else {\n            showErrorOverlay(\n                \"Daily route request limit reached\",",

if refresh should proceed, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func shouldRefresh(isVisible: Bool) async -&gt; Bool {\n        guard settings.autoRefreshDeviceList,\n              isVisible else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        // Check application state on main thread\n        let isActive = await MainActor.run {\n            UIApplication.shared.applicationState == .active\n        }\n        \n        guard isActive else {\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        let interval = Double(settings.mapUpdateInterval)\n        let now = Date()\n        \n        if let last = lastRefresh, now.timeIntervalSince(last) &lt; interval {\n            // Throttle: do not refresh yet\n            return false\n        }\n        \n        return true\n    }\n    \n    /// Refreshes all device locations if conditions are met (throttling, visibility, app state).\n    /// - Parameters:\n    ///   - isVisible: Whether the view requesting the refresh is currently visible\n    ///   - forceGeocoding: Whether to force geocoding for all devices\n    /// - Returns: &#96;true&#96; if refresh was performed and succeeded, &#96;false&#96; otherwise\n    func refreshIfNeeded(isVisible: Bool, forceGeocoding: Bool = false) async -&gt; Bool {\n        ",
